given.note: Ben T.'s number texts again after his key was erased (K-04 seed-sealing-key: erased 2026-11-02). No person on the handle holds a key, so, as at first sight, the call writes a person with no name linked to the handle and that person's key, and the gateway seals the text with it: a stop in other words, START, HELP or a danger text from this number is still recorded (open gap 18, closed). Ben's erased key stays erased and his link stays; nothing of his is unsealed.
